markers.description: phonology/tone note. Copy the full printed label into the value, e.g. \np Tone: LM (do not emit LM alone).
sense number (printed as circled digits ①, ②)
classifier note (▪ in print). Copy the full printed phrase into the value, e.g. \nt Commonly used classifier: mi˩ (do not emit mi˩ alone).
cross-reference (printed after 'See:'). Keep the target lemma only (no 'See:' prefix).

rules: Entry boundaries: \lx initiates the record. Homographs are distinguished by a subsequent \hm.
Grammar header: emit \ps and \np on separate lines (do not merge POS and tone onto one line).
Multiple senses: Introduced by \sn (1, 2) prior to the definition bundles.
Trilingual definitions: Translations follow the sequence \de (English), \dn (Chinese), \dr (French).
Examples: Bundles start with \xv (marked by ¶ in print), followed by free translations (\xe, \xn, \xr) or interlinear grammatical glosses (\xg).

Note-field values: for \np and \nt, preserve the dictionary's printed English label text verbatim from the transcription (e.g. Tone: LM; Commonly used classifier: mi˩). The marker selects the field role; the label is part of the value, not a separate marker.
